decisions.salts: keep the largest carbon-containing fragment; ties by heavy atoms, heteroatoms and canonical SMILES; ties are flagged
decisions.charges: formal charges kept; structures are never neutralised
decisions.tautomers: not canonicalised or merged; only label-conflicting tautomer groups are flagged
decisions.stereo: isomeric SMILES preserved; stereo-blind feature map limitation flagged
decisions.conflicting_labels: structures with both labels excluded; no external evidence to choose one
decisions.elements: explicit Pauling table, no numeric fallback; missing elements raise an error
